body: Can you please explain what's inconsistent about this? I'm not sure I understand this issue.

@IgorMinar Sure, by saying `inconsistent` I mean either to choose a style with spaces inside the interpolation binding syntax or without spaces. 
For example, `{{ hero.name }}` and `{{hero.name}}`

@IgorMinar Is there a preferred style? (https://angular.io/guide/styleguide does not use spaces in the examples it shows, but it doesn't specify explicitly.) I can make a note in our docs on creating examples, at least for internal consistency as we make other changes to examples. Thanks.
